rule: Retain the existing 300 Creator codes; add these 10,000 as a separate code set. Do not replace or renumber existing stable IDs.
Ship only SHA-256 hashes and reward references. Never place plaintext giveaway codes in Assets, StreamingAssets, Resources, logs, or public builds.
Normalize input as uppercase alphanumeric only (remove spaces and hyphens) before SHA-256 matching. Validate compatibility with the existing CODES tab normalizer.
Current offline behavior is exact-once per campaign save, not globally one-use. Global single-use requires the future Anime Dojo account/entitlement service.
Keep CodeId stable so the future website can mark one code globally redeemed without changing the in-game reward payload.
No public giveaway code may grant Margin, Redactor Forge, Author Seal, Vaultbearer, private signing, or hidden authorization.
Use the existing reward, XP, inventory, equipment, save, and code redemption services. Do not create duplicate systems.
Weapons enter Guild inventory and never auto-equip. Player comparison, equip, unequip, locks, and loadouts remain authoritative.
Personal, Art, Weapon, Union, and Relationship XP vouchers require explicit player target selection. Guild and Hall XP may apply globally.
Standard-safe preparations, XP, boosts, modded weapons, and Ultimate Legacy weapons must also be earnable through story, Tower, level, skill-use, boss, or city milestones.
Ω Creator weapons are owner-controlled, mark the save CREATOR_POWER_USED, remain noncanon/sandbox, and are not competitively eligible.
Code rewards may accelerate power but cannot skip locked story chapters, reveal protected lore, recruit Kael/Founders, or auto-complete objectives.
Redemption, reward application, save receipt, and UI confirmation must be atomic and idempotent; reload/reopen cannot duplicate rewards.
Equipment instance generation uses the code row InstanceSeed and must produce the same item after save/reload.
Test all 10,000 hashes, all reward references, duplicate codes/hashes, all weapon families, all XP types, all preparation IDs, save migration, and built-player redemption.
